identity.name: MEDILO
design_principles: Function over Form: No decoration without purpose.
High Contrast: Legibility is patient safety.
Density: Information density for pros, clarity for patients.
State Awareness: Every status (Pending, Approved, Rejected) must be visually distinct.

usage_rules: Never use gradients under any circumstances. Solid backgrounds only.
Text must be #161616 (Black) or #525252 (Dark Grey). Never pure black on white.
Primary color #0F62FE is ONLY for primary actions (Submit, OTP Verification, Login).
Destructive color #DA1E28 is for error alerts and invalid validation states.

layout.spacing_system: Generous but structured. Use p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12.

containers.card: bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm rounded-md p-6 sm:p-8
containers.mobile_shell: min-h-screen bg-background pb-20 max-w-md mx-auto px-4

styles.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-sm font-medium h-11 px-6 text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-primary
styles.secondary: bg-white border border-gray-300 text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 h-11 px-6 text-base

inputs.style: border-gray-300 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary bg-white h-11 px-3 text-base

cards.style: bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

badges.style: font-mono text-xs font-medium px-2 py-0.5 uppercase

customer_login.target_device: Mobile-first PWA (constrained preview width max-w-md on desktop)
customer_login.layout_structure: Single column clinical PWA layout centered with fixed header badge, top pharmacy trust bar, clear tab switch between 'Sign In' & 'Register', phone input with '+91' prefix & format hint, OTP flow trigger, clear license/compliance notice footer, and quick navigation switcher pills for Staff and Delivery logins.
visual_hierarchy: Header: Medilo Pill/Cross Logo + 'India Closed Pilot • Licensed Pharmacy Portal' status badge
Title Section: 'Customer Sign In' with subtext 'Enter your 10-digit mobile number for instant OTP authentication'
Auth Mode Switch: Segmented pill toggle for [ Existing Customer / New Register ]
Form Section: Mobile input (+91 standard prefix with flag icon/label), full name input when Register mode is active, Terms check notice
Action Button: Full-width primary blue button ('Get OTP' / 'Complete Registration')
Trust Signals Banner: 3-column micro trust strip [ 100% Verified Medicines | Licensed Pharmacists | Encrypted Audit Trail ]
Role Portal Switcher: Clean grey card footer with quick tabs to 'Staff Portal (Pharmacist / Ops)' and 'Delivery Partner Portal'

staff_login.layout_structure: Split-screen desktop design (Left 5-col: Deep clinical brand & compliance panel with active operational stats, Right 7-col: High-efficiency email/password staff authentication form).
visual_hierarchy: Left Panel (Brand & Operational Panel): Dark Navy #161616 background with IBM Blue #0F62FE accent accents, live system operational status badge ('MEDILO v2.4 • System Operational'), compliance notices, and quick stats (Licensed Pharmacist Verification Active, Schedule H/H1 Audit Logging Enabled).
Right Panel (Auth Form Container): Clean #F4F7F6 background with white central card container.
Role Selection Tabs: [ Pharmacist | Pharmacy Staff | Operations Admin ] to pre-fill or tag login intent.
Form Fields: Staff Email (@medilo.in / registered domain) with Icon + Password with show/hide toggle.
Security Note: 'Restricted Access: Authorized Clinical & Ops Personnel Only. All activities logged.'
Action Button: Primary button 'Sign In to Staff Workspace'
Footer Link: 'Switch to Customer Mobile Portal' / 'Delivery Partner Portal'

delivery_login.layout_structure: Clean high-contrast operational layout optimized for mobile field agents.
visual_hierarchy: Header: 'Delivery Partner Portal' with Truck/Package Icon badge
Form Section: Registered Mobile Number input + Partner ID (optional)
Footer: Link back to Customer & Staff portals

trust_signals: CDSCO / State Pharmacy License Compliance Badge
Schedule H / H1 Prescription Protocol Badge
Closed Pilot Access Tag (300 Verified Users)
micro_interactions: Smooth tab transition between Sign In and Register states
Focus state highlighting with 2px solid IBM Blue outer ring
Disabled state on loading with spinner icon and 'Verifying credentials...'
Sonner notification toast triggers on validation error or OTP dispatch

visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for dropdowns. No large diffuse shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Minimal. Only for sticky headers: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b.

accessibility.contrast: WCAG AA Required. Text on colored badges must be legible.

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICTLY follow the color coding for medicines: Green (OTC), Yellow (Sch H), Red (Sch H1).
Customer App is MOBILE VIEW ONLY. Use max-w-md mx-auto for desktop preview of customer app.
Pharmacist/Ops Dashboards are DESKTOP VIEW ONLY. Use full width.
Do not use 'framer-motion' for complex animations. Simple transitions only.
Ensure all inputs have labels and validation states.
For tables, use Shadcn Table component with dense padding.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use sonner for toasts
Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
